description:
List innovation flags, strongest first.

    Use this when you want links between claims rather than the claims themselves.
    Every flag includes flag_type and summary. summary is the short reason to follow the pair or skip it.
    flag_type is lexical for a shared keyword, cross_domain for evidence overlap across primary domains, contradiction for a stored disagreement, or innovation for higher-strength synergy.
    Older rows may still use lexical_association, scientific_connection, or research_hypothesis.
    Returns flag id, domain, summary, strength, flag_type, connected_domain, the claim ids on each path, and a claims array in that same order.
    Each claims item has claim_id, statement, and evidence strength. Full evidence stays on get_evidence.
    connected_domain is the primary domain of the claim that does not match the flag domain.
    It is null when the claims share a primary domain.
    Optional cross_domain_only, when true, returns only flags whose connected_domain is set.
    Repeated claim paths return once, keeping the strongest flag for that pair.
    A low evidence strength is included unless min_strength is set.
    Example: get_innovation_flags(domain="ai-ml", min_strength=0.5, limit=10).
    Example: get_innovation_flags(domain="quantum", min_strength=0.8, limit=5).
    Example: get_innovation_flags(domain="consciousness", cross_domain_only=True, limit=10).

cross_domain_only.description: When true, return only flags whose connected_domain is set. Default false.
cross_domain_only.title: Cross Domain Only

domain.description: Restrict flags to one domain. Example: ai-ml.
domain.title: Domain

min_strength.description: Drop flags below this strength, from 0 to 1. Example: 0.5.
min_strength.title: Min Strength

offset.description: Number of hits to skip. Example: 0.
offset.title: Offset

name: get_innovation_flags

claims.description: Claims on this path, in claim_path order. Each item has claim_id, statement, and evidence strength.
claims.title: Claims

connected_domain.description: Primary domain of the claim that does not match this flag's domain. Null when the claims share a primary domain.
connected_domain.title: Connected Domain

flag_type.description: Kind of link. lexical is shared-term context. cross_domain is evidence overlap across primary domains. contradiction is a stored disagreement. innovation is higher-strength synergy or an evidence-chain extension. Older rows may still say lexical_association, scientific_connection, or research_hypothesis.

summary.description: Short reason this pair was flagged. Use it to follow the link or skip it.
summary.title: Summary

FlagPathClaim.description: One claim on a flag path. Evidence and contradictions stay on get_evidence.
FlagPathClaim.title: FlagPathClaim

FlagType.description:
How a flag should be read. A missing value loads as lexical_association.

lexical, cross_domain, contradiction, and innovation are the kinds the
flag pass writes. The three older labels stay valid for rows already stored.
FlagType.title: FlagType
